figurative_meaning_en: Unparalleled and extraordinary; unique and incomparable
example_sentences_in_english: Her voice is one without a second.
This artwork is unparalleled and unique.
history: Derived from the Chandogya Upanishad in the Vedas, expressing the monistic concept of the ultimate reality (Brahman) as one without a second.
note: This idiom has roots in ancient Sanskrit philosophy and is used in Bengali to denote absolute uniqueness.
